safety.title: Safety & reliability
safety.short: TravelMate only works with partners that meet top quality and trust standards.
safety.full:
We carefully select licensed hotels, resorts and travel providers that are highly rated by guests and follow international safety standards.

Every partner must pass a review of its facilities, service process and refund policy. TravelMate makes sure you always get reliable, transparent, quality service.

refund.title: Flexible refund policy
refund.short: Change or cancel bookings easily, with fast refunds.
refund.full:
If you need to change your plans or cancel a booking, TravelMate will help you according to each hotel's policy.

Refunds are processed quickly and transparently to protect your rights in every case. We also keep you updated on the refund status by email and in your account.

privacy.title: Customer data privacy
privacy.short: Your personal data is encrypted to the highest security standards.
privacy.full:
TravelMate is committed to protecting your information. All personal data, payment details and transaction history are kept secure.

We never share your information with third parties without your consent.

support.title: 24/7 customer support
support.short: Our support team is always available.
support.full:
You can reach the TravelMate support team anytime via hotline, email or live chat.

Our specialists and 24/7 chatbot are ready to answer your questions and quickly handle issues such as refunds, booking changes or complaints.

system.title: About the platform
system.intro: Our booking platform is built to make travel smart, convenient and safe. Using AI, we suggest the destinations that suit you best and help you pick the best hotel at a fair price.
system.smartText: AI-powered hotel suggestions for a better experience.
system.supportText: Our customer care team is always ready to help.

about.title: About us
about.text: TravelMate – a smart travel booking platform connecting you with trusted, quality hotels nationwide.
